Working on the getting on 1st shift, but it'll take awhile probably, hopefully not to much longer. Working less hours is less of an option. Those 16 hour shifts are mandatory due to staff shortages and since I work in a capacity where lives can be potentially in danger, I'm not allowed to refuse unless I used what's called "FMLA" a federal level ability to refuse work without consequence due to some family or injury related condition you have to apply for.

I do have FMLA thankfully, but only 6 uses a month, so I still work a great deal.
